videos.title: The Weirdest Tools Ever Made Explained In 7 Minutes
videos.description:
Most tools in a workshop make sense the second you look at them — a hammer hits, a wrench turns. Then there are the ones that look like they belong in a horror movie or a magic trick, and somehow they're still sitting in real toolboxes today. In this video, we break down nine of the strangest, most specifically built tools ever engineered and explain exactly why each one exists.
Whether it's a hammer that only works backwards, a wrench built to stop a barrel from exploding, or a tool that measures things by feel alone, this is a list of tools most people outside the trade have never even heard of.

If you're into tools, workshop skills, or just like understanding how things work, this one's for you.

Got a weirder tool sitting in your own garage? Drop it in the comments — we want to hear about it.

videos.title: Every Type of Pliers Explained | Part 1
videos.description:
Pliers look like the simplest tool in the box — two handles, a pivot, done. But grab the wrong pair and you'll strip a bolt, crack a plastic hose fitting, or realize halfway through the job that the tool in your hand physically can't do what you're asking it to. In this video, we break down every type of pliers and explain exactly what each one is designed to do.

Whether you're pulling a stuck hose off a fitting, cutting wire without a scissor action, locking a workpiece hands-free for welding, or removing a retaining ring buried inside a bore, this is the only reference you'll need.

If you're into tools, workshop skills, or just like understanding how things work, this one's for you.
